title: Claude Rebuilt This AI Video in Unreal Engine (Zero Imported Assets)
author: Disastrous-Round-150
selftext:
**MattVidPro: Turning AI video into playable procedural scenes with Claude, Shader Skills and Unreal Engine**

Thought this would interest the AI game dev community! MattVidPro demonstrates how Claude Opus 5.5 recreates a fictional Seedance game clip as a playable browser shader in around 45 minutes using gokaygokay’s Shader Skills. He then takes the idea into Unreal Engine 5.8, creating an explorable pirate cabin with procedurally built objects and no imported assets. The video covers the workflow, results, limitations and API costs.

**I take no credit for any of this. Credit goes to MattVidPro for the video and his video-to-Unreal skill, and Gökay Aydoğan (gokayfem / gokaygokay) for Shader Skills. I’m simply sharing their work with the AI game dev community.**
